name: The Second Rebellion
summary: At the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, Sergeant Yohwa calls for aid against Colonel Kurzen's overwhelming force. Outnumbered ten to one, the rebels cannot fight a long, open war. They strike swiftly and in secret, hoping to thin Kurzen's ranks and ease the pressure on their refuge.

sections.title: A Losing Battle
sections.body:
At the Rebel Camp, the rebels face Colonel Kurzen's force with at least ten foes for every one of their own. Sergeant Yohwa knows the Colonel is a brilliant military tactician. An open war of attrition would leave the rebels with no chance.

So they turn Kurzen's covert methods against him. They strike quickly at his encampment, then flee before heavy reinforcements can answer.

sections.title: Striking the Compound
sections.body: Sergeant Yohwa asks you to head east into Kurzen's stronghold and eliminate a sizable contingent of his jungle fighters. Their numbers press hard on the Rebel Camp. Thin their ranks, and the refuge can breathe easier.

faq.answer: Sergeant Yohwa is an officer at the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale. He coordinates covert strikes against Colonel Kurzen's host.

faq.q: Where is Colonel Kurzen's camp located?
faq.answer: Colonel Kurzen's compound lies east of the Rebel Camp, amid the dense wilderness of northern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why are the rebels using covert tactics instead of open war?
faq.answer: The rebels face at least ten of Colonel Kurzen's fighters for every one of their own. Against a brilliant military strategist, an open assault is impossible, so they depend on swift guerrilla strikes.

faq.q: What comes after The Second Rebellion?
aliases: what is after the second rebellion
follow up to the second rebellion
faq.answer: After you cut down Kurzen's jungle fighters, Sergeant Yohwa offers the next step, Special Forces.
